title: WayPOP: A Panoramic Open-Set Panoptic Tracking Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.05801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Holistic perception for autonomous agents requires reliably segmenting and associating scene elements across time and camera views, including objects outside a fixed semantic taxonomy. Existing open-set panoptic benchmarks focus on individual images or views, while panoramic tracking benchmarks assume closed-set taxonomies. Consequently, these benchmarks do not evaluate whether unknown objects can be consistently segmented and tracked across synchronized multi-camera sequences. We introduce WayPOP, a panoramic open-set panoptic tracking benchmark built on real Waymo PVPS sequences augmented with diverse out-of-taxonomy 3D assets from Objaverse. Inserted objects are placed at fixed locations in the 3D scene and rendered using calibrated vehicle-mounted cameras as the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic move, providing temporally and cross-view consistent panoptic annotations and auxiliary LiDAR range observations. translated_title: WayPOP：一个环视开放集全景分割跟踪基准
translated_abstract: 自主智能体的整体感知需要在时间和相机视角之间可靠地分割并关联场景元素，包括固定语义分类体系之外的物体。现有的开放集全景分割基准仅关注单张图像或单一视角，而环视跟踪基准则假设封闭集分类体系。因此，这些基准无法评估未知物体能否在同步的多相机序列中被一致地分割与跟踪。我们提出了 WayPOP，这是一个建立在真实 Waymo PVPS 序列之上、并通过来自 Objaverse 的多样化分类体系外 3D 资产进行增强的环视开放集全景分割跟踪基准。插入的物体被放置在 3D 场景中的固定位置，并在自车与周围交通运动时使用标定好的车载相机进行渲染，从而提供时间和跨视角一致的全景分割标注以及辅助的 LiDAR 距离观测。WayPOP 包含约……（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: WayPOP 是一个环视开放集全景分割跟踪基准，通过在真实 Waymo PVPS 序列中插入 Objaverse 的分类体系外 3D 物体并渲染多相机与 LiDAR 数据，检验未知物体能否在同步多相机序列中被一致地分割和跟踪。
en_tdlr: WayPOP is a panoramic open-set panoptic tracking benchmark that augments real Waymo PVPS sequences with diverse out-of-taxonomy 3D assets from Objaverse to evaluate whether unknown objects can be consistently segmented and tracked across synchronized multi-camera sequences.
